# nexspence_blobstore (Resource)

A Nexspence blob store (local filesystem, S3, or a group of other stores).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Local filesystem blob store.
resource "nexspence_blobstore" "local" {
  name = "main"
  type = "local"
  path = "./data/blobs/main"
}

# S3-compatible blob store (MinIO / AWS S3).
resource "nexspence_blobstore" "s3" {
  name = "s3-store"
  type = "s3"
  s3 = {
    bucket           = "my-nexspence-blobs"
    region           = "us-east-1"
    endpoint         = "https://minio.example.com"
    access_key       = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
    secret_key       = var.s3_secret_key
    force_path_style = true
  }
}

# Group blob store — spread writes across two physical stores.
resource "nexspence_blobstore" "tiered" {
  name = "tiered"
  type = "group"
  group = {
    fill_policy = "write_to_first_fill"
    members     = [nexspence_blobstore.local.name, nexspence_blobstore.s3.name]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `group` (Attributes) Group members and fill policy (type = group). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group))
- `path` (String) Filesystem path (type = local).
- `quota_bytes` (Number)
- `s3` (Attributes) S3 connection settings (type = s3). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

### Nested Schema for `group`

Required:

- `fill_policy` (String) How writes pick a member: round_robin or write_to_first_fill.
- `members` (List of String) Member blob store names (resolved to IDs). Groups cannot nest.
